bioconda.name: bioconductor-similarpeak
bioconda.summary: Metrics to estimate a level of similarity between two ChIP-Seq profiles

biotools.summary: This package calculates metrics which quantify the level of similarity between ChIP-Seq profiles. More specifically, the package implements six pseudometrics specialized in pattern similarity detection in ChIP-Seq profiles.
